target: Anclaje del ramal A del Camino de la Tierra Húmeda.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / ARCHITECTURE — NO CREATURE. Restos visibles de una instalación de agua fuera de uso. No definir por qué fue abandonada ni inventar su interior inferior.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / ARCHITECTURE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide exterior scene of Molino Hundido along a wet Edran–Lethra side channel. Show the weathered remains of a modest old water installation: part of a simple wheel structure and low masonry/timber base subsided unevenly into the bank, with water passing through and vegetation reclaiming it. The ruin is incomplete and ordinary, not monumental. Any lower access is obscured by water, mud and structure; its abandonment remains unexplained.
negative_constraints: No large medieval millhouse or picturesque fantasy inn
No explanation of abandonment through bodies, battle damage or magic
No runes, treasure, monsters or supernatural water
No characters or creatures as focal subject
notes: Fiel al anclaje geográfico canónico. No definir interior, jefe, secreto ni mecánica.
